identification: Three small items. (1) Long steel-pinned hat/stick pin with rose-gold coloured disc head (about 10-12 mm) set with a round opal cabochon (looks like a solid or doublet opal showing blue-green fire); head unmarked in the photo, catalogue says 9ct. (2) Oval brooch of about 17 faceted black stones (French jet / black glass, not carved Whitby jet) on a hand-written paper tag reading 'Antique Whitby carved jet'; pin-back is steel. (3) Pair of boxed dress studs in a green velvet case: gilt/rose-gold-tone bases with white-metal bezels set with black onyx or glass cabochons.

viewing_check: Look for a 9ct/375 or 'rolled gold' stamp on the hat pin disc and on the stud backs, loupe the opal (solid vs doublet, cracks), test or weigh the pin, check studs are gold-filled/plated, and look at the brooch under the loupe (faceted glass vs true jet).
